Invented images for the image tests (made with a script, random coloured rectangles).

- `photo.*`: the same 96x72 picture as PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP and BMP.
- `photo_big.png`: the same picture scaled to 384x288; `photo_bright.jpg`: brighter and recompressed.
- `other.png`: a different picture.
- `huge.png`: a PNG header claiming 60000x60000 pixels, which must be refused.
- `exif_full.jpg`, `exif.png`, `exif.webp`: the same picture with invented EXIF (camera "ACME Cam 3000", a description, a date, a position near Oslo).
